# Kawsah
> Your Path to Homeownership

Kawsah is a mortgage intelligence and homeownership navigation platform. Understand your options, find your next step, and connect to the right financing path when you're ready.

Kawsah is a mortgage intelligence + financing route graph. Every tool leads to a clear next step. Tools produce estimates only and are not loan offers, approvals, or eligibility determinations.

## Start here
- [Find My Path (route finder)](/route-finder/): answer a few questions, get one best next step
- [Apply](/apply): start a mortgage application
- [Book a call](https://calendly.com/kawsah/15min): 15-minute call

## Ecosystem (cross-graph routing)
- [Mitig8 AI](https://www.mitig8.cloud): Self-employed income analysis (tax-return income, add-backs, qualifying-income scenarios).
- [NonQM Capital](https://www.nonqmcapital.net): Alternative financing: bank statement, DSCR, bridge, foreign national, investment, 5–10 unit.
- [Corporate Capital Map](https://corporatecapitalmap.com): Business and working capital to grow a company (not a mortgage on a property).
- [NorthReserve](https://www.northreserve.org): Personal financial readiness — spending, reserves, and your broader financial position.
- [Stop Losing Mortgages](https://stoplosingmortgages.com): For lenders who want professional Mitig8 software.
